about: A small Windows daemon that keeps your live Outlook Inbox and Sent Items clean by archiving every message into a separate Archives data file, while logging each one and popping a desktop toast so nothing is missed.

steps.title: Log it
steps.body: Full sender, subject and body go to a rolling log file.

steps.title: Toast it
steps.body: A Windows toast shows the message as it arrives.

steps.title: Mark it read
steps.body: Inbox items are marked as read automatically.

steps.title: Archive it
steps.body: The item moves into the Archives PST, so the live Inbox and Sent Items stay empty.

features.title: Starts at logon
features.body: Registers a Task Scheduler job, and a watchdog restarts the daemon if it dies.

features.title: One-click control
features.body: Start, stop, toggle and restart scripts, plus a taskbar launcher.

features.title: Sweep what's already there
features.body: A one-shot sweep archives items that were in the mailbox before you started.
